summary: Opened the exact order-received URL in a fresh isolated headless Chrome context and performed only read-only navigation, DOM inspection and a screenshot. No links or controls were activated, no form was submitted, and no order, payment or email action occurred.
issues: OC-INT-001 (blocked, missing genuine order identity): the route returns HTTP 200 but has neither an order ID in the path nor a WooCommerce order key. It renders one generic thank-you notice, zero order overviews, zero order-detail blocks, zero assigned route sections, zero main controls and zero forms. An approved existing native order ID/key is required to audit the real completed-order state; the audit must not create or place an order. No page or console errors were observed, but that does not validate the unavailable state.
